dedupe_keys.name: baltic power system model input output databases from spineopt eem 2023 and rtucon 2024

description: Baltic power system model input/output databases from SpineOpt (EEM 2023 and RTUCON 2024) is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kārlis Baltputnis (Riga Technical University). This deposit provides four SpineOpt input and output databases (SQLite) for the Baltic power system modelling workflow (github.com/flpp-signature/Baltic-Model). The workflow is used to build and run open-source optimisation models of the Baltic power system for scenario analysis and model calibration/validation. The deposit includes the corresponding input databases (Input_EEM_2023.sqlite, Input_RTUCON_2024.sqlite) and output databases (Output_EEM_2023.sqlite, Output_RTUCON_2024.sqlite). Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
